system.description:
Lore: Relic Cloak (Bound)

The drow cut of the same enchantment, black as the Underdark and twice as smug about it. It has the following Powers:

  • Invisibility I: While the hood is up, skip your Move to become Invisible until after you take an Action. Beings have Hinder on Checks to notice you even after that.

Value: 5000g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)
